result:
All six fixes are in. I re-rendered every sheet and MP4, viewed them, and re-ran `tools/check.js`. Every pose still reaches its targets, planted feet still don't slide, and all three loops start and end on pixel-identical frames.

1. **Optimus head and legs:** the head is now a white rounded helmet over the top and back, with a glossy black visor whose back edge curves round the side. There's a white band above it and a slim neck, so it no longer reads as half-and-half. Thighs and calves are fuller. A new front view on the sheet shows a black oval face inside a white helmet rim.
2. **Climb:** the torso is nearly upright and close to the ladder, hands grip rungs at about head height, and each limb steps up one rung at a time. Knees still poke slightly past the ladder in side view.
3. **Elon bite:**
   - One chunk of food leaves the plate on the fork and is gone after the bite.
   - The Optimus now walks in from off-screen right with a fresh plate. Elon stops in front of it and takes the bite.
   - Afterwards the Optimus turns and leaves right with the plate, and Elon follows a moment later without passing through it.
   - The fresh plate only appears off-screen.
   - The clip is now 8.8 s, longer than before because of the extra walking.
4. **Cybercab:** 4.3 × 1.45 m with a short hood and a tall glass canopy peaking near the B-pillar. The roof runs in one arc down to a short cut-off tail. Wheel diameter is about 48% of the height, overhangs are small, and the light bars are white across the nose and red across the tail. The door is one piece (gold skin plus glass) hinged at the A-pillar top, with a hinge stub. The sheet shows closed, half open and open.
5. **Model Y:** now a fastback crossover with a rounded nose, raked windshield, an arched roof sloping into the hatch, a small ducktail, one glass band and a thin B-pillar. The black car has a lighter outline and highlight line.
6. **Cybertruck:** a true single-peak wedge with straight lines from the nose to an apex just behind the windshield top, then down to the tailgate. It has flat panels with a side crease, a light bar across the nose and trapezoid wheel arches.

**Still weak:**
- The Cybercab shape is matched to your description, not checked against photos.
- In the fully open state, the Cybercab door leans more up-and-back than forward. The forward swing is only suggested by narrowing the door.
- The Semi is unchanged.
- The Optimus hands are still simple mittens.
- The MP4s run 6.7 s, 7.0 s and 8.8 s.

Everything is in `/workspace/tesla-factory/v3/figures/out/`:
- optimus-sheet.png
- elon-sheet.png
- cybercab-sheet.png
- vehicles-sheet.png
- overview-sheet.png
- optimus-walk-carry-place.mp4
- elon-walk-bite.mp4
- cybercab-drive-doors.mp4
